question: What is the Leave Policy?
short_answer: All full-time employees are entitled to 18 days of Paid Annual Leave (PAL) per calendar year, credited monthly at 1.5 days.
detailed_answer: All full-time employees are entitled to 18 days of Paid Annual Leave (PAL) per calendar year, credited monthly at 1.5 days. Employees are entitled to 12 days of Sick Leave per year; leave beyond 3 consecutive days requires a medical certificate. 5 Casual Leave days per year are provided for short-notice personal matters. Unused Paid Annual Leave up to 10 days can be carried forward to the next calendar year; the remainder lapses on 31 December.
escalation_path: HR Executive -> HR Business Partner -> HR Manager -> HR Director

question: What is the Attendance Policy?
short_answer: Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour lunch break.
detailed_answer: Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour lunch break. Employees must clock in/out via MK-HRMS biometric or mobile check-in. A grace period of 15 minutes is allowed for late arrival, up to 3 times per month. More than 3 late arrivals in a month require attendance regularization approval from the Reporting Manager.
escalation_path: HR Executive -> HR Business Partner -> HR Manager -> HR Director

question: What is the Remote / Hybrid Work Policy?
short_answer: MK-Infinite-AI follows a hybrid model: employees are expected in the office 3 days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday).
detailed_answer: MK-Infinite-AI follows a hybrid model: employees are expected in the office 3 days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). Fully remote work arrangements require Department Director and HR approval. Employees working remotely must be reachable during core hours of 11 AM to 4 PM. Remote work from outside the employee's registered home country requires prior HR and IT Security approval.
escalation_path: HR Executive -> HR Business Partner -> HR Manager -> HR Director

question: What is the Employee Conduct Policy?
short_answer: Employees are expected to treat colleagues, customers, and vendors with professionalism and respect.
detailed_answer: Employees are expected to treat colleagues, customers, and vendors with professionalism and respect. Harassment, discrimination, or retaliation of any kind is strictly prohibited and grounds for immediate disciplinary action. Conflicts of interest must be disclosed to the Reporting Manager and HR Business Partner. Confidential company and customer information must not be shared outside authorised channels.

question: What is the Promotion Policy?
short_answer: Promotions are considered twice a year, in the April and October promotion committee cycles.

question: What is the Internship Policy?
short_answer: Internships run for a minimum of 8 weeks and a maximum of 6 months.

question: Can an employee from a different department ask a Human Resources question?
short_answer: Yes. Human Resources knowledge is retrievable company-wide; only documents marked restricted or management-level require extra authorization.
detailed_answer: MK-Infinite-AI's knowledge base does not gate department knowledge behind the requester's own department. An employee from any department can ask a Human Resources question (for example, an IT employee asking about the leave policy). Access is instead controlled per-document via the 'access_level' and 'allowed_departments' metadata, so general employee-facing knowledge remains available company-wide while restricted or management-level documents stay protected.
